newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal airport selloff seen late 97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal airport selloff seen late 97 - paper.

text.p: A senior government official told a Lisbon newspaper that Portuguese state airport company ANA-Aeroportos e Navegacao Aerea was undergoing a reorganisation before a privatisation expected in late 1997.

Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos told Diario de Noticias that two new companies would be created from the present ANA -- one to handle air traffic control and the other to run the airport facilities.
The latter would be privatised at the end of 1997, he said.
Teixeira dos Santos also said it may be possible to privatise motorway company Brisa in the first half of 1997.
He added that the Finance Ministry was preparing to privatise a 23 percent stake in cargo terminal company Tertir in a bloc sale next year.
